messages:
sara: :rotating_light: Seeing a sudden spike of 5xx and streaming timeouts on hosted inference (client-stream route) starting ~03:15 UTC. p95 for streaming endpoints jumped to 9s and we have ~120 distinct client errors. Noticing a cluster of aborted streams from a single customer and lots of upstream 502/504s. Opening war room.

matt: copying logs now. curl to repro attached below. initial failure pattern looks like connection resets + 502 from edge proxy. can someone grab traceroutes?```curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"repeat x10000"}'``` 

dmitri: grabbing proxy traces. early hypothesis: long-lived chunked streaming requests are exhausting keepalive slots on ingress NLB -> sidecar proxy then fails to handshake to runtime, resulting in 502. also seeing kv-cache warmup spikes when model instances cold-start, amplifying tail latency. logs: "connection reset by peer" then "upstream 502 chunked encoding error".

ops-bot: Incident created: IR-2025-1765432987. Pager duty alerted. Current mitigation: 1) Route new streaming requests to fallback pool (policy: fallback-lowconcurrency) 2) Increase keepalive/connections on sidecar to 300 temporarily 3) Disable continous-batching for long-stream routes for the burst window. Applying now.

linh: I pushed the route override to send streaming to fallback pool (canary) — traffic shifted. Monitoring metrics.

matt: after route move, 5xx rate dropped ~60% in the affected AZ. customers still see some timeouts but overall improvement. :thumbsup:

sara: good. can we gather repro steps for support and note exact headers that trigger the proxy bug? support-escalations, share with CS.

support-escalations: noted. We'll reach out to impacted customer with repro checklist: 1) curl above, 2) attach full request with chunked transfer and keepalive disabled, 3) timestamped client-side logs. Drafting comms.

dmitri: quick note on root cause candidates: a) NLB keepalive + sidecar file descriptor exhaustion on sustained long-lived streaming connections b) KV cache cold-start causing additional blocking RPCs to model runtime during handshake c) sidecar bug where chunked transfer termination sometimes mis-parsed when upstream reconnects mid-stream.

matt: temp patch proposal: increment sidecar keepalive to 600, enforce max-stream-duration of 60s at proxy, and add backpressure metric export to detect stream saturation early. Can we fast-roll that to prod for 2 hours as mitigation? We need ops approval.

linh: approved for 2-hr emergency config change. will roll to all active ingress clusters in 5m.

ops-bot: Config change rolled at 03:42 UTC. Observability: p95 streaming latency back to ~1.2s, 5xx count trending down. Continue monitoring for 1h.

sara: thanks team. Postmortem action items (assignments): - dmitri: full root cause analysis on sidecar chunked parsing (ETA 3d) - matt: implement max-stream-duration + early backpressure metrics (ETA 2d) - linh: automations to route to fallback pool when keepalive exhaustion detected (ETA 5d) - support-escalations: customer comms and follow-up (ETA next business day). Add any other tasks.

dmitri: adding a test harness to probe chunked termination edge cases and reproduce in CI. I'll also check kernel fd limits and container configs.

support-escalations: comms sent to impacted customers with workaround and apology. We'll follow-up with timeline for permanent fix.

sara: closing war room for now — leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Add links to dashboards and saved traces to the incident ticket. :lock:
